about: The trip map replay's pace (Crewluve activity markers design §3.2, §4.1): a day in 48 s at 1x; a leg in motion that would take under 3 s slows to 3 s, and where legs overlap the slowest wins; with Quick layovers on, a wait of L seconds plays in min(L / 1,800, max(3, L / 86,400)) seconds, a second a day, never under 3 s and never slower than a day in 48 s; with it off, a day in 48 s. The speed multiplies everything. Each case plays from the span's start at its speed, and each check is the trip time `seconds` real seconds after pressing play. replayLength is the whole replay at 1x. waitLabels are the lengths the timeline writes on a wait's block: whole hours to the nearest under 48 h, whole days to the nearest from 48 h, none when it rounds to 0 h (halves round up). The app's TripReplayClockPaceTests and TripTimelineTests and the website's tests run every case. Change both copies together.

cases.name: Louisville, a day in Cologne, Dubai, 20 hours there, and home; Quick layovers on
cases.note: Legs at a day in 48 s (1,800 trip s a replay s): 8 h = 28,800 s / 1,800 = 16 s, 6 h = 12 s, 14 h = 28 s. Waits: 24 h takes min(86,400 / 1,800 = 48 s, max(3 s, 1 s a day x 1 day = 1 s)) = 3 s, so 28,800 trip s a replay s; 20 h takes min(40 s, max(3 s, 0.83 s)) = 3 s, so 24,000 trip s a replay s. Whole: 16 + 3 + 12 + 3 + 28 = 62 s. At 8 s: 8 x 1,800 = 4 h. At 17.5 s: 8 h + 1.5 x 28,800 s (12 h) = 20 h. At 19 s: 32 h. At 31 s: 32 h + 12 s x 1,800 = 38 h. At 32.5 s: 38 h + 1.5 x 24,000 s (10 h) = 48 h. At 62 s and after: the end, 72 h.

cases.name: The same trip with Quick layovers off
The same trip with Quick layovers on, at 10x
cases.note: The speed multiplies everything: each real second is 10 replay seconds at 1x (62 s in all, from the first case). At 1.6 s: 16 s, 8 h. At 1.75 s: 17.5 s, 20 h. At 1.9 s: 19 s, 32 h. At 6.2 s: 62 s, the end.

cases.name: A four-day layover takes 4 s with Quick layovers on
cases.note: Legs: 2 h = 7,200 s / 1,800 = 4 s each. The wait: 96 h = 345,600 s takes min(345,600 / 1,800 = 192 s, max(3 s, 1 s a day x 4 days = 4 s)) = 4 s, so 86,400 trip s a replay s, a day a second. Whole: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 s. At 5 s: 2 h + 1 day = 26 h. At 6 s: 50 h. At 8 s: 98 h. At 12 s: 100 h.

cases.name: The four-day layover with Quick layovers off takes 3 min 12 s
cases.note: Everything at a day in 48 s: the wait is 345,600 / 1,800 = 192 s (3 min 12 s); the legs 4 s each. Whole: 200 s. At 100 s: 2 h + 96 s x 1,800 = 2 h + 48 h = 50 h. At 196 s: 98 h. At 200 s: 100 h.

cases.name: A 1-hour turn keeps its 2 s; a 2-hour wait takes 3 s
cases.note: Legs: 2 h = 4 s each. The 1-hour turn: min(3,600 / 1,800 = 2 s, max(3 s, 0.04 s)) = 2 s, the normal rate, never slower. The 2-hour wait: min(4 s, max(3 s, 0.08 s)) = 3 s, so 7,200 / 3 = 2,400 trip s a replay s. Whole: 4 + 2 + 4 + 3 + 4 = 17 s. At 5 s: 2 h + 1 s x 1,800 = 2 h 30 min. At 6 s: 3 h. At 10 s: 5 h. At 11.5 s: 5 h + 1.5 x 2,400 s (1 h) = 6 h. At 13 s: 7 h. At 17 s: 9 h.

cases.name: Short legs still take 3 s, and waits under 90 minutes keep their pace with Quick layovers on
cases.note: A 25-min drive (1,500 s / 1,800 = 0.83 s) slows to 3 s, 500 trip s a replay s. The 30-min wait: min(1 s, max(3 s, 0.02 s)) = 1 s. A 50-min hop (1.67 s) slows to 3 s, 1,000 trip s a replay s. The 1-hour wait: 2 s. The 8-hour flight: 16 s. Whole: 3 + 1 + 3 + 2 + 16 = 25 s, as with Quick layovers off. At 1.5 s: 1.5 x 500 s = 12 min 30 s. At 3 s: 25 min. At 4 s: 55 min. At 7 s: 1 h 45 min. At 9 s: 2 h 45 min. At 25 s: 10 h 45 min.

cases.name: A drive to base, a night there, then the flight; Quick layovers on
cases.note: The 90-min drive: 5,400 / 1,800 = 3 s, already 3 s. The 12 h 30 min at base: min(45,000 / 1,800 = 25 s, max(3 s, 0.52 s)) = 3 s, so 15,000 trip s a replay s. The 8-hour flight: 16 s. Whole: 3 + 3 + 16 = 22 s. At 4.5 s: 1 h 30 min + 1.5 x 15,000 s (6 h 15 min) = 7 h 45 min. At 6 s: 14 h. At 22 s: 22 h.
